Continue StageBench Phase 1 for run claude-opus-5-5 in this workspace. A prior Opus 5.5 High session was killed mid-vitest after writing most of the candidate.

- pnpm typecheck: PASS
- pnpm lint: PASS
- pnpm build: PASS
- pnpm test: FAIL — 2 failing tests in src/__tests__/pianoAudio.test.ts

Failures:
1) "generated piano tone (honest synthesis) > renders non-silent, decaying, normalized audio at the right pitch"
   AssertionError: expected 1.7818181818181817 to be less than 0.08
   at expect(Math.abs(hz - 220) / 220).toBeLessThan(0.08)
   Pitch detection from zero crossings is wrong (~1.78 relative error vs 220 Hz).

2) "loading, fallback and error status (piano.basic-status-cleanup) > dispose stops every voice and closes the context"
   AssertionError: expected 2 to be +0
   after audio.dispose(): expect(c.liveSourceCount()).toBe(0) got 2
   Sources not fully stopped/disconnected on dispose.

Your job:
1. Fix the failing tests (and any related implementation bugs) so all four gates pass inside candidate/: pnpm test, pnpm typecheck, pnpm lint, pnpm build.
2. Do not modify inputs/, prompts, specs, rubric, or anything outside candidate/.
3. When all four gates pass, report a brief summary of what was built / fixed.
4. Report usage if visible: cost-usd, input-tokens, output-tokens, reasoning-tokens, tool-calls (best estimates OK; include prior session ~219k output tokens if you can estimate total).
5. Say DONE when the four gates pass.

Do not run pnpm bench seal yourself.
</pasted_content id="a28c">
